content.description: Hallucinogenics is a psychedelic-themed NFT micro-series based on Cardano blockchain. Q: What is Hallucinogenics?A: Hallucinogenics is a psychedelic-themed CNFT micro-series. This option is only available for wallets staked with PSYA - Psychedelic pool before the 18th of April (date of the snapshot for the whitelist). The reservation time is 30 minutes, please make sure to make your payment within that time, otherwise your tx will be refunded. Price is 42 per NFT, or a little discount in a bundle with 2 or 3 NFts. If you use other wallets that are not on the list, or if you use a HW wallet , it's recommended to select the QR core option and send the tx manually.
